stage_title: R Research the rest of the parts
item: Say when to run the chassis and body research (wave 3: brakes, driveline, steering, suspension, wheels, body - about 400 parts, several million tokens)
note: Tick it when you want wave 3 to run; R2 waits on it. Waves 1 and 2 are the electrical, lighting, ignition, engine, fuel, cooling, climate and transmission parts.

stage_title: R Research the rest of the parts
item: Merge wave 2 (engine, fuel, cooling, climate, transmission) into the record
note: Merge wave 2 (13 of 18 batch files exist in 01-REFERENCE/research/research/: climate-14/16/17, cooling-18, engine-35..39, fuel-41, transmission-52; climate-15, fuel-40, transmission-53/54/57 were lost in a scratch folder and must be run again). The merge reads that folder by default and is idempotent (P48).

stage_title: K Where it is not recorded
item: Read the VIN (chassis number) off the plate - through the windshield at the base of the dash on the driver side, and on the door-jamb label - and type it in full
note: 00-CAR vehicle.vin is not recorded. The serial number in it (FB331 ......) decides which of two catalogue parts the car left the factory with for 18 of the rows below; once typed, the agent settles those rows from the catalogue's serial ranges and drops them from your list (plan P29).

stage_title: K Where it is not recorded
item: Read the TRIM code off the colour plate (same plate as the paint code, 04-beauty:B01): the two-character interior colour code, e.g. 00 black, 08 white
note: 53 rows below doubt only which colour variant of a part is fitted; the trim code settles them from the catalogue, and the agent drops them from your list once it is typed (plan P29).

stage_title: K Where it is not recorded
item: Re-read the 8 catalogue entries whose scan was unreadable (a digit or suffix blank) against a second source - a parts dealer's listing or the other catalogue edition
note: G3, H1 and six more rows cannot be settled by looking at the car: the doubt is in the scan, not on the car. Web or second-catalogue check (plan P29).

stage_title: I Under the car (on stands)
item: Put the car on stands (or a lift) for the underside checks, and say when it is up
note: The 20 stage-I rows need the car off its wheels; they are gated here so they leave your list until the car is up (plan P29).

stage_title: R Research the rest of the parts
item: Install an OCR tool once (sudo dnf install ocrmypdf) so wave 3 reads the scanned manuals as text, not 800 page images per batch
note: The four key PDFs (S-001, S-002 Section 15, S-005, S-038) are image-only scans: pdffonts shows 0 fonts and pdftotext returns nothing. Every research agent pays vision tokens to re-view the same pages. After the install, the agent runs ocrmypdf --sidecar over them into 01-REFERENCE/model/library/docs/ and the research prompt greps first (P48).
